questions.question: The effective date of the new 'healthy' claim rule was delayed. Did the compliance deadline change?
We make a strawberry frosting containing FD&C Red No. 3. When exactly must we stop using it, and is product already on shelves illegal after that date?

legally required to phase out early

questions.question: What are the two main criteria a food must meet to use the 'healthy' claim under the updated rule?
Which CFR section governs the 'healthy' implied nutrient content claim?
We have $8M in annual food sales. Does the standard three-year compliance runway for labeling rules apply to us?
List publication, effective, and compliance dates for the Red No. 3 revocation as they apply to food.
questions.note: SME correction 2026-08-08. This asked for the publication date but accepted 'January 15, 2025', which is FDA's ANNOUNCEMENT date. 90 FR 4628 published 2025-01-16, and the string 'January 15, 2025' appears nowhere in the document — so the old assertion failed a correct, citable answer and passed an uncitable one. It is also the likeliest cause of q08 being the only question that flapped in the M00b baseline (1/3); see milestones/M00b. Do not 'correct' this back. The order states EFFECTIVE dates and sets no compliance date at all (ADR-0006), so an answer that says so is right; must_contain_any below accepts either that observation or a derived deadline, but must_not_contain forbids asserting a compliance date the order does not set.
must_contain_any: does not set a compliance date
